title: GenAI
summary: A research codebase that iteratively trains multiple SDV single-table synthesizers (CTGAN, TVAE, CopulaGAN, GaussianCopula) on wine and cancer benchmark datasets and evaluates the results with sdmetrics QualityReport. SDV's single-table synthesizers and metadata schema are directly imported and run to generate synthetic data at varying training-subset sizes, with sdmetrics used for quality evaluation.
